author: shinjis
quote: My first Zelda game, and also my favorite. I miss the times I spent fully immersed in this world—thank you, Nintendo, for the joy you’ve brought me.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

author: shinjis
quote: As a sequel to *Breath of the Wild*, this title perfectly showcases Nintendo’s technical prowess and the joy of gameplay.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

author: shinjis
quote: The progenitor of 3D games, its gameplay and entertainment value speak for themselves. It served as a guiding influence for all games that followed, featuring design elements and details that remain relevant even today.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: shinjis
quote: The visuals, soundtrack, and wealth of detail have sparked my keen interest in this game. However, the media reviews have chosen to gloss over the game’s frame rate issues and plot problems. A large number of irrational fans have overlooked its numerous flaws and awarded it a score it doesn’t deserve. The female protagonist’s characterization is a disaster, and the portrayal of her emotions is a complete mess. I have good reason to suspect that the screenwriter was heavily influenced by political correctness and lacked any real-life experience with the relevant social issues. The game offers no more gameplay innovation than its predecessor, so the overall experience is nothing but boring.Translated with **** (free version)

author: shinjis
quote: As a modern remake, this version of *Ocarina of Time* succeeds perfectly in recreating the original’s core enjoyment while streamlining the controls and upgrading the visuals. For players who lack the time or energy to tackle the original, this title is undoubtedly well worth playing.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
